title: Mulch Dog ResourcePack
description: mulch totem + mulch crosshair, thats so cool am i right
body:
This resource pack makes the Totem of Undying turn into "Mulch" a pretty fun thing if you ask me.
Not only that, this makes your crosshair turn into Mulch too!!!! Mulch will go everywhere with you.
You can customize this if you get tired of mulch, just change the content in the resourcepack folder.
